mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 22 degrees and partly cloudy near Badger Prairie County Park under the full moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Property tax bills will arrive by December 15, and you have several ways to pay including online, by mail, or at the drop boxes at the City Center. You can also manage payments through your BS and A online account if you need assistance.

There is plenty to do in town today with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow you can look forward to live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.

In a report from November 2, officers responded to a residence on West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance which resulted in the arrest of a 48-year-old man for battery and disorderly conduct.
The Culver's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake and the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy your treat.
